description: We are a team of four high school students passionate about science, technology, space exploration, and innovation. We are eager to learn, collaborate, and develop creative solutions to real-world challenges using NASA's open data. We value teamwork, curiosity, research, and different perspectives. We welcome motivated people who want to contribute their skills and ideas to our project!
summary: An illustrated storytelling video about Spirit and Opportunity rovers
details: Our project is an illustrated storytelling video about the twin rovers Spirit and Opportunity left behind on Mars.
